Start.Name: original_01_5092066370a0
Start.Text: 刚才你说玩乐队，是什么意思……？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_01_original_07_98a88cd511d7
l2d_voice#2.Text: 真是的，小立希！ 小灯，加油哦！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_02_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_002
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小祥！太好了～你终于来了！ 你全身都湿透了！没事吧！？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_04_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_004
l2d_voice#2.Text: 你没有来学校上课，给你发信息也不回——

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_06_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_010
l2d_voice#2.Text: 等一下…… 先坐下再说吧……？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_original_02_39c4a56e35d3
l2d_voice#2.Text: 啊，说的也是。 不好意思——

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_11_original_05_6650192ece06
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小睦现在沉睡在她体内

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_12_original_06_aa3423870bd4
l2d_voice#2.Text: 大家只是错过了彼此， 一定能重归于好……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_13_original_08_c09c3ed54bba
l2d_voice#2.Text: 只是稍微看了一下乐谱， 就能做出这样的编曲……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_14_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_012
l2d_voice#2.Text: 不能告诉我们吗？还是说，就是我们造成的？ 有问题我们可以改正的……
